stemMd: Why does the new label retain the early cataloger's description?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To let visitors compare judgments based on different evaluative questions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To show that the curator accepts clumsy as the only correct interpretation.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To prove that the patch was added before the jacket was made.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To hide the museum's earlier decision to store the jacket.

explanationMd: The label deliberately juxtaposes interpretations. Keeping the earlier judgment allows visitors to see how an emphasis on original appearance differs from an emphasis on continued use.

distractorRationale.b: The label includes a contrasting interpretation.
distractorRationale.d: Retaining and attributing the description makes that earlier judgment visible.
distractorRationale.c: The passage states the patch came later.
